concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-010 (sensitivity analysis over density weightings and α values) has no corresponding task. No task in tasks.md schedules re‑running the simulation and regression with alternative configurations, nor records the results.

Success Criterion SC-002 (regime‑map PNG must be ≤ 5 MB) is not verified by any task. Neither T017 (visualize regime map) nor any integrity task includes an explicit file‑size check, so the size constraint is untested.
